AddGatewayQuotaRule.description_en: Creates a gateway quota throttling rule
AddGatewayQuotaRule.description_zh: 新增网关配额限流规则

AddGatewaySecurityGroupRule.description_en: Authorizes a security group for gateway access to services
AddGatewaySecurityGroupRule.description_zh: 授权网关访问服务的安全组

BatchAddConsumerGroupConsumers.description_en: Adds members to a consumer group in batches
BatchAddConsumerGroupConsumers.description_zh: 批量添加消费者组成员

BatchDeleteConsumerAuthorizationRule.description_en: Revokes API consumer authorization rules in batches
BatchDeleteConsumerAuthorizationRule.description_zh: 批量解除消费者授权规则

BatchRemoveConsumerGroupConsumers.description_en: Removes consumer group members in batches
BatchRemoveConsumerGroupConsumers.description_zh: 批量移除消费者组成员

BatchUpdateHttpApiOperation.description_en: Updates HTTP API operations in batches
BatchUpdateHttpApiOperation.description_zh: 批量更新 HTTP API 操作

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Moves a resource to a different resource group

CheckCommodityStatus.description_en: Queries the activation status of the API management service
CheckCommodityStatus.description_zh: 获取API管理服务开通状态

CreateChatSession.description_en: Creates a HiMarket chat session with a specified conversation type and associated products, and returns the ID of the newly created session
CreateChatSession.description_zh: 创建一个 HiMarket 聊天会话，可指定对话类型与关联的产品，创建成功后返回新建会话的 ID

CreateDeveloper.description_en: Registers a HiMarket developer account and returns the ID of the new developer
CreateDeveloper.description_zh: 注册一个 HiMarket 开发者账号，创建成功后返回新建开发者的 ID

CreateHttpApiOperation.description_en: Creates operations for an HTTP API

CreateHttpApiRoute.description_en: Creates a route for an HTTP API

CreateMcpServer.description_en: Creates a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
CreateMcpServer.description_zh: 创建一个模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器

CreatePluginWorkspace.description_en: Creates a WebIDE workspace for a plugin

CreatePolicyAttachment.description_en: Creates a policy attachment to a resource

CreatePortal.description_en: Creates a HiMarket developer portal and returns the ID of the newly created portal
CreatePortal.description_zh: 创建一个 HiMarket 开发者门户，创建成功后返回新建门户的 ID

CreateProduct.description_en: Creates an API product in the product catalog of the HiMarket portal and returns the ID of the new product upon successful creation
CreateProduct.description_zh: 在 HiMarket 门户的产品目录中创建一个 API 产品，创建成功后返回新产品的 ID

CreateProductCategory.description_en: Creates a product category for an API product and returns the ID and name of the new category upon success
CreateProductCategory.description_zh: 创建一个 API 产品的产品类别，创建成功后返回新类别的 ID 和名称

CreateProductRef.description_en: Associates an API configuration with a specified API product by submitting the gatewayId and apigRefConfig parameters to the /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/ref endpoint. The association result can be queried by using GetProductRef on the same path and removed by using DeleteProductRef
CreateProductRef.description_zh: 为指定的 API 产品关联 API 配置：在 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/ref 上提交 gatewayId 与 apigRefConfig，关联结果可由同路径的 GetProductRef 查询、由 DeleteProductRef 解除

DeleteConsumerAuthorizationRule.description_en: Deletes an API consumer authorization rule

DeleteGatewayQuotaRule.description_en: Deletes a quota throttling rule from a gateway
DeleteGatewayQuotaRule.description_zh: 删除网关某条配额限流规则

DeleteGatewaySecurityGroupRule.description_en: Deletes a gateway security group rule

DeleteHttpApiRoute.description_en: Deletes a route of an HTTP API

DeletePortal.description_en: Deletes a specified HiMarket developer portal by portal ID
DeletePortal.description_zh: 按门户 ID 删除指定的 HiMarket 开发者门户

DeleteProduct.description_en: Deletes a specified API product by API product ID
DeleteProduct.description_zh: 按 API 产品 ID 删除指定的 API 产品

DeleteProductCategory.description_en: Deletes a specified product category by product category ID
DeleteProductCategory.description_zh: 按产品类别 ID 删除指定的产品类别

DeleteProductRef.description_en: Dissociates an API product from an API by API product ID. This association is established by CreateProductRef on the same resource path and can be queried by GetProductRef
DeleteProductRef.description_zh: 按 API 产品 ID 解除该 API 产品与 API 的关联；该关联由 CreateProductRef 在同一资源路径上建立，可通过 GetProductRef 查询

DeployHttpApi.description_en: Publishes an HTTP API. This includes REST APIs and routes within HTTP APIs
DeployHttpApi.description_zh: 发布HTTP API。包括Rest API 和HTTP API里的路由

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions where the cloud-native API gateway is available for the current account
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询当前账号可见的云原生API网关开服地域

GetAiModelCard.description_en: Queries the details of an AI model card

GetAiModelProvider.description_en: Queries the details of an AI model provider

GetApiPathFieldConfig.description_en: Queries the effective field collection configurations for an HTTP API across each URI of the request in a specified cloud-native API gateway, including the field source, JSONPath, collection status, switch permission, and whether the configuration is derived from a field template
GetApiPathFieldConfig.description_zh: 查询指定云原生 API 网关下某个 HTTP API 在各请求路径上已生效的字段采集配置，包括字段来源、JSONPath、是否采集、是否允许切换与是否来自字段模板

GetApiPathFieldTemplate.description_en: Queries the field template corresponding to an API request path and returns the template name, applicable protocol, template description, and the set of fields defined by the template (field key, JSONPath, value source, and statistical category)
GetApiPathFieldTemplate.description_zh: 按 API 请求路径查询该路径对应的字段模板，返回模板名称、适用协议、模板说明以及模板定义的字段集合（字段键、JSONPath、取值来源与统计类别）

GetBatchImportTask.description_en: Queries a batch import task. The task ID is returned after a batch import task is created by calling BatchImportHttpApis. Pass an empty string to list all existing batch import tasks
GetBatchImportTask.description_zh: 查询批量导入任务。任务 ID 由 BatchImportHttpApis 创建批量导入任务后返回；传入空字符串可列出所有已有的批量导入任务

GetDashboard.description_zh: 获取监控日志大盘接口

GetDeveloper.description_en: Queries the account information of the currently logged-on developer and returns the developer ID, portal ID, username, and status
GetDeveloper.description_zh: 查询当前登录开发者的账号信息，返回其开发者 ID、所属门户 ID、用户名与状态

GetGateway.description_en: Queries the basic information of a gateway, such as the associated VPC, vSwitch, and gateway endpoint
GetGateway.description_zh: 获取网关的所属VPC，所属交换机, 网关入口等基本信息

GetGatewayElasticPolicy.description_en: Retrieves the elastic scaling rule of a gateway

GetGatewayQuotaRule.description_en: Queries the details of a gateway quota throttling rule
GetGatewayQuotaRule.description_zh: 查询网关配额限流规则详情

GetGatewayQuotaRuleSubjectUsage.description_en: Queries the usage details of a subject for a gateway quota throttling rule, including the used quota, total quota, over-limit status, usage details, and consumption records
GetGatewayQuotaRuleSubjectUsage.description_zh: 查询网关配额限流规则主体用量详情，包括已用配额、总配额、是否超限、用量详情及消费记录等

GetGatewayResourceQuotaUsage.description_en: Queries the resource quotas and usage of a gateway
GetGatewayResourceQuotaUsage.description_zh: 查询网关资源配额与用量

GetHiMarketConsumer.description_en: Queries the details of a single HiMarket consumer by consumer ID and returns the consumer ID, name, description, and whether the consumer is the primary consumer
GetHiMarketConsumer.description_zh: 按消费者 ID 查询单个 HiMarket Consumer 的信息，返回消费者 ID、名称、描述以及该消费者是否为主消费者

GetHiMarketConsumerCredential.description_en: Queries the credential information of a HiMarket consumer by consumer ID. The response includes API key and HMAC credential configurations. The credential members are defined by the common data structures HiMarketApiKeyConfig and HiMarketHmacConfig
GetHiMarketConsumerCredential.description_zh: 按消费者 ID 查询该 HiMarket Consumer 的凭证信息，返回 API Key 凭证配置与 HMAC 凭证配置两类容器，凭证成员由公共数据结构 HiMarketApiKeyConfig 与 HiMarketHmacConfig 定义

GetHttpApiRoute.description_en: Retrieves the route details of an HTTP API

GetMigrationNamespacedServices.description_en: Retrieves the namespaced services for a migration task
GetMigrationNamespacedServices.description_zh: 获取迁移的命名空间服务

GetPluginWorkspace.description_en: Queries the WebIDE workspace of a plugin

GetPolicyAttachment.description_en: Queries the resource attachment of a policy

GetPortal.description_en: Queries the details of a single HiMarket developer portal by portal ID and returns the portal name, description, region ID, portal settings, and portal domain name configurations
GetPortal.description_zh: 按门户 ID 查询单个 HiMarket 开发者门户的详情，返回该门户的 Portal 名称、Portal 描述、地域 ID、Portal 配置与 Portal 域名配置

GetProduct.description_en: Queries the details of a single API product by API product ID, and returns information such as the name, description, status, type, documentation, icon, whether subscription requests are automatically approved, MCP/Agent/model configurations, product capability configurations, and the region
GetProduct.description_zh: 按 API 产品 ID 查询单个 API 产品的详情，返回名称、描述、状态、类型、说明文档、图标、是否自动审批订阅、MCP/Agent/模型配置、产品能力配置与所属地域等信息

GetProductCategory.description_en: Queries the details of a product category by ID and returns the ID, name, description, and icon of the category
GetProductCategory.description_zh: 按产品类别 ID 查询单个产品类别的详情，返回该类别的 ID、名称、描述与图标

GetProductRef.description_en: Queries the API configurations associated with an API product by API product ID and returns the gateway ID and APIG association configuration
GetProductRef.description_zh: 按 API 产品 ID 查询该产品当前关联的 API 配置，返回关联所在的网关 ID 与 APIG 关联配置

GetRiskNotification.description_en: Retrieves the notification configuration for a risk item

GetSecretValue.description_en: Retrieves the value of a secret

GetService.description_en: Retrieves the details of a service

GetSource.description_en: Retrieves the details of a service source

HandleOidcCallback.description_en: Executes the callback step in the OIDC logon flow by submitting the code and state query parameters via a GET request, and returns the accessToken, tokenType, and expiresIn fields in the response data
HandleOidcCallback.description_zh: OIDC 登录流程中的 Callback 步骤，以 GET 方式提交回调携带的 code 与 state 两个查询参数，响应的 data 返回 accessToken、tokenType 与 expiresIn 三个字段

ImportHttpApi.description_en: Imports an HTTP API. You can import an OpenAPI 2.0 or OpenAPI 3.0.x definition file as a REST API
ImportHttpApi.description_zh: 导入HTTP API，支持将OpenAPI 2.0和 OpenAPI 3.0.x版本的定义文件导入为REST类型的API

InitiateOidcAuth.description_en: Initiates the Authorize step in the OIDC logon process based on the OIDC provider identifier. The response body defined by the API operation contains only the requestId, code, and message fields, and does not declare the business response parameter data
InitiateOidcAuth.description_zh: OIDC 登录流程中的 Authorize 步骤，按 OIDC 提供方标识 provider 发起登录；接口定义的响应体只有 requestId、code 与 message 三个字段，未声明业务出参 data

ListAiModelCards.description_en: Queries a list of AI model cards

ListAiModelProviders.description_en: Queries the list of AI model providers

ListApiPathFieldTemplates.description_en: Performs a paging query on the field template list and returns the template ID, request path, and applicable protocol for each template record
ListApiPathFieldTemplates.description_zh: 分页查询字段模板列表，返回每条模板记录的模板 ID、对应的 API 请求路径与适用协议

ListBatchExportTasks.description_en: Queries a list of batch export tasks
ListBatchExportTasks.description_zh: 查询批量导出任务列表

ListChatSessions.description_en: Performs a paged query on the list of HiMarket chat sessions, returning the session ID, name, conversation type, and associated API products for each session. The response also includes the paging page number, paging size, and total count
ListChatSessions.description_zh: 分页查询 HiMarket 聊天会话列表，每个会话返回会话 ID、名称、对话类型以及关联的 API 产品，响应同时返回分页页码、分页大小与总数量

ListConsumerAuthorizationRules.description_en: Retrieves the list of consumer authorization rules
ListConsumerAuthorizationRules.description_zh: 获取消费者授权规则列表

ListConsumerGroupConsumers.description_en: Queries the member list of a consumer group
ListConsumerGroupConsumers.description_zh: 查询消费者组成员列表

ListConsumerGroupQuotaRules.description_en: Queries the list of quota throttling rules for a consumer group
ListConsumerGroupQuotaRules.description_zh: 查询消费者组配额限流规则列表

ListConsumerGroups.description_en: Queries the list of consumer groups

ListConsumerQuotaRules.description_en: Queries the list of quota rules configured for a specific consumer
ListConsumerQuotaRules.description_zh: 查询某个消费者上已配置的配额规则列表

ListConsumers.description_en: Retrieves a list of API consumers

ListDevelopers.description_en: Performs a paged query for the HiMarket developer list. You can filter the paging results by portal ID, username, and developer status. The response includes the developer ID, portal ID, username, and status
ListDevelopers.description_zh: 分页查询 HiMarket 开发者列表，可按门户 ID、用户名和开发者状态筛选，返回开发者 ID、所属门户、用户名与状态

ListDomains.description_en: Queries a list of domain names

ListExternalServices.description_en: Retrieves external service information for a gateway
ListExternalServices.description_zh: 获取网关的外部服务信息

ListGatewayAuthorizableSecurityGroups.description_en: Queries the list of security groups that can be authorized for a gateway
ListGatewayAuthorizableSecurityGroups.description_zh: 查询网关可授权安全组列表

ListGatewayAuthorizedSecurityGroupRules.description_en: Queries the list of security group rules authorized for a gateway
ListGatewayAuthorizedSecurityGroupRules.description_zh: 查询网关已授权安全组规则列表

ListGatewayErrorAccessLogs.description_zh: 列出网关错误访问日志

ListGatewayFeatures.description_en: Queries the list of gateway attribute parameter settings
ListGatewayFeatures.description_zh: 查询网关特性参数配置列表

ListGatewayLoadBalancers.description_en: Retrieves the list of load balancers for a gateway

ListGatewayQuotaRules.description_en: Queries the FinOps quota rules associated with a gateway
ListGatewayQuotaRules.description_zh: 查询网关上绑定的FinOps配额规则列表

ListHiMarketConsumerSubscriptions.description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the API product subscriptions of a specified HiMarket consumer. You can filter subscriptions by status. Each subscription record in the paging response includes the subscription ID, the ID, name, and type of the subscribed API product, the consumer ID and name, and the subscription status
ListHiMarketConsumerSubscriptions.description_zh: 分页查询指定 HiMarket Consumer 的 API 产品订阅列表，可按订阅状态筛选，每条订阅返回订阅 ID、被订阅的 API 产品 ID/名称/类型、消费者 ID/名称以及订阅状态

ListHiMarketConsumers.description_en: Performs a paging query on the HiMarket consumer list. You can filter consumers by name keywords, portal ID, and developer ID. The response includes the ID, name, description, and primary status of each consumer
ListHiMarketConsumers.description_zh: 分页查询 HiMarket Consumer 列表，可按 Consumer 名称关键词以及门户 ID、开发者 ID 作为查询条件筛选，每个消费者返回消费者 ID、名称、描述以及是否为主消费者

ListHttpApiOperations.description_en: Retrieves a list of API operations

ListHttpApiRoutes.description_en: Queries the route list of an HTTP API

ListHttpApis.description_en: Retrieves a list of HTTP APIs

ListInstallableGateways.description_en: Retrieves gateways on which a plugin can be installed

ListK8sClusterSources.description_en: Queries the list of clusters that can be added as Kubernetes sources
ListK8sClusterSources.description_zh: 查询可添加为K8S来源的集群列表

ListMcpProductTools.description_en: Queries the details of Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools in an MCP Server-type API product and returns a list of tools. Each tool contains three text fields (name, title, and description) and four map fields (inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations, and meta)
ListMcpProductTools.description_zh: 查询 MCP Server 类型的 API 产品所包含的 MCP 工具详情，返回工具列表，每个工具返回名称、标题、描述三个文本成员与 inputSchema、outputSchema、annotations、meta 四个 map 结构成员

ListMcpServers.description_en: Retrieves a list of MCP servers

ListModelCards.description_en: Queries a list of model cards and returns the model name, provider, and source identifier for each card, along with the features, pricing, meta, availablePaths, and snapshots structures. The only business request parameter is the provider identifier
ListModelCards.description_zh: 查询模型卡片（ModelCard）列表，返回每张卡片的模型名称、模型供应商与来源标识，并给出该卡片的 features、pricing、meta、availablePaths、snapshots 结构；唯一业务入参是模型供应商标识 provider

ListMseNacosSources.description_en: Queries the list of instances that can be added as Nacos sources
ListMseNacosSources.description_zh: 查询可添加为Nacos来源的实例列表

ListPluginAttachments.description_en: Retrieves the list of plug-in mounts

ListPluginRepositories.description_en: Queries the list of repositories and organization information for custom plugins hosted on Codeup. Before calling this operation, enable code hosting on Codeup, create organizations and repositories, and authorize API Gateway to access the Codeup account
ListPluginRepositories.description_zh: 查询自定义插件托管在云效上的仓库列表和组织信息。调用前需先在云效（Codeup）开通代码托管、创建组织和仓库，并完成 APIG 访问 Codeup 账号的授权

ListPluginWorkspace.description_en: Retrieves the list of plugin WebIDE workspaces for the current user
ListPluginWorkspace.description_zh: 获取用户插件webide工作空间列表

ListPortalPublications.description_en: Performs a paged query for the list of published API products on a specified HiMarket developer portal. The paging result contains list items, each returning the publication record ID, API product ID, API product name, and API product type
ListPortalPublications.description_zh: 分页查询指定 HiMarket 开发者门户上已发布的 API 产品列表，每个列表项返回发布记录 ID、API 产品 ID、API 产品名称与 API 产品类型

ListPortals.description_en: Performs a paged query for the list of HiMarket developer portals under the current tenant. Each list item in the paging result returns the portal ID, portal name, portal description, region ID, portal settings, and portal domain configurations
ListPortals.description_zh: 分页查询当前租户下的 HiMarket 开发者门户列表，每个列表项返回门户 ID、Portal 名称、Portal 描述、地域 ID、Portal 配置与 Portal 域名配置

ListProductCategories.description_en: Queries the list of product categories for the current tenant with paging. You can search by category name keywords. Each item in the list includes the category ID, category name, category description, and category icon
ListProductCategories.description_zh: 分页查询当前租户下的产品类别列表，入参可按类别名称关键词搜索，列表项返回类别 ID、类别名称、类别描述与类别图标

ListProductPublications.description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the publication information of a specified API product, which is a list of portal records to which the product is published. Each list item contains the publication record ID, portal ID, portal name, API product ID, API product name, and API product type. The results can be filtered by portal name and parameter query based on paging
ListProductPublications.description_zh: 分页查询指定 API 产品的发布信息，即该产品已发布到的门户记录列表，列表项包含发布记录 ID、门户 ID、门户名称、API 产品 ID、API 产品名称与 API 产品类型，并可按门户名称与分页参数查询

ListProductSubscriptions.description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the list of subscribe records for a specified API product. You can use paging to filter the records by subscribe status and search them by keywords in the consumer name. Each record includes the subscribe ID, API product ID and name, API product type, consumer ID and name, and subscribe status
ListProductSubscriptions.description_zh: 分页查询指定 API 产品的订阅记录列表，可按订阅状态筛选，也支持按消费者名称关键词搜索；每条记录返回订阅 ID、API 产品 ID 与名称、API 产品类型、消费者 ID 与名称以及订阅状态

ListProducts.description_en: Queries the list of API products under the current tenant by using paging. You can specify the product name, type, status, category, and the published portal in the request. The response includes the product ID, name, description, status, type, documentation, icon, product category, automatic approval of subscriptions, and the MCP, agent, model, and capability configurations
ListProducts.description_zh: 分页查询当前租户下的 API 产品列表，入参可指定产品名称、产品类型、Product 状态、产品类别与产品发布的门户，列表项返回产品 ID、名称、Product 描述、状态、类型、说明文档、图标、Product 分类、是否自动审批订阅以及 MCP/Agent/模型配置与产品能力配置

ListPublishableProducts.description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the list of API products that can be published to a specified HiMarket developer portal. The request accepts the portal ID, API product name, and paging parameters. Each item in the response includes the API product ID, name, and description
ListPublishableProducts.description_zh: 分页查询可发布到指定 HiMarket 开发者门户的 API 产品列表，入参可指定门户 ID、API 产品名称与分页参数，列表项返回 API 产品 ID、API 产品名称与 API 产品描述

ListSyncMCPServer.description_en: Lists MCP servers that are pending synchronization
ListSyncMCPServer.description_zh: 列出待同步的 MCP 服务器

ListTagResources.description_en: Retrieves a list of resource tags

ListZones.description_en: Retrieves the zones available for a cloud-native API gateway in a specified region
ListZones.description_zh: 获取云原生API网关region下的可用区

LoginDeveloper.description_en: Logs in to a HiMarket developer account by using a developer username and password, and returns the accessToken and expiresIn fields in the data object of a successful response
LoginDeveloper.description_zh: 使用开发者用户名与密码登录 HiMarket 开发者账号，成功响应的 data 中返回 accessToken 与 expiresIn 两个字段

LogoutDeveloper.description_en: Logs a developer out of a HiMarket developer account. This operation takes no business request parameters. A successful response returns only the requestId, code, and message fields
LogoutDeveloper.description_zh: 开发者登出 HiMarket 开发者账号。本接口没有业务入参，成功响应只返回 requestId、code 与 message 三个字段

PublishProduct.description_en: Publishes a specified API product to a specified HiMarket portal. The path parameter specifies the API product ID, and the request body specifies the target portal ID. This operation returns the publication record ID for the publication. You can query the publication record by calling ListProductPublications and unpublish the product by calling UnpublishProduct at /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications/{publicationId}
PublishProduct.description_zh: 把指定的 API 产品发布到指定的 HiMarket 门户：路径参数给出 API 产品 ID，请求体给出目标门户 ID，调用后返回本次发布的发布记录 ID。发布记录可由获取API产品的发布信息（ListProductPublications）查询，可由下线API产品（UnpublishProduct）按 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications/{publicationId} 下线

QueryConsumerAuthorizationRules.description_en: Queries the list of consumer authorization rules
QueryConsumerAuthorizationRules.description_zh: 查询消费者授权规则列表

RefreshPluginOAuthCode.description_en: Refreshes the OAuth code for the plugin-managed repository
RefreshPluginOAuthCode.description_zh: 刷新插件托管仓库的oauth code

RemoveConsumerAuthorizationRule.description_en: Deletes an API consumer authorization rule

ResetGatewayQuotaRule.description_en: Resets a quota throttling rule on a gateway
ResetGatewayQuotaRule.description_zh: 重置网关上某条配额限流规则

RunPluginPipeline.description_en: Runs a pipeline in a plug-in workspace
RunPluginPipeline.description_zh: 插件工作空间运行流水线

SubscribeProduct.description_en: Subscribes to an API product on a specified HiMarket consumer. The path parameter specifies the consumer ID, and the request body specifies the ID of the API product to subscribe to. The response returns the subscription ID, API product ID and name, API product type, consumer ID and name, and subscription status of the subscription record
SubscribeProduct.description_zh: 在指定的 HiMarket Consumer 上订阅一个 API 产品：路径参数给出消费者 ID，请求体给出要订阅的 API 产品 ID，调用后返回该订阅记录的订阅 ID、API 产品 ID 与名称、API 产品类型、消费者 ID 与名称以及订阅状态

UnDeployMcpServer.description_en: Cancels the publishing of an MCP server

UndeployHttpApi.description_en: Cancels the deployment of an HTTP API

UnpublishProduct.description_en: Unpublishes a publication record of an API product based on the API product ID and the publication record ID. Both identifiers are parameters in the /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications/{publicationId} path. The publication record is created by the PublishProduct operation and can be queried by the ListProductPublications operation. This operation only manages the publication record and does not delete the API product itself. To delete a product, use DeleteProduct. The response returns only the requestId, code, and message
UnpublishProduct.description_zh: 按 API 产品 ID 与发布记录 ID 下线该 API 产品的一条发布记录：两个标识同为 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications/{publicationId} 路径上的参数，发布记录由发布API产品（PublishProduct）产生、可由获取API产品的发布信息（ListProductPublications）查询。本接口只操作发布记录，不删除 API 产品本身（删除产品请使用 DeleteProduct），响应只返回 requestId、code 与 message

UpdateCategoryProducts.description_en: Adds or removes API products in bulk under a specified product category. The path parameter specifies the category ID, the action in the request body specifies the operation direction, and productIds specifies the list of API product IDs to process. The response returns only the requestId, code, and message, and does not return item-by-item processing results
UpdateCategoryProducts.description_zh: 在指定的产品类别下批量添加或移除 API 产品：路径参数给出类别 ID，请求体的 action 给出本次操作的方向，productIds 给出要处理的 API 产品 ID 列表。响应只返回 requestId、code 与 message，不返回逐条处理结果

UpdateDeveloperStatus.description_en: Updates the status of a HiMarket developer by developer ID. The request body specifies the target status and portal ID. A successful response returns only the requestId, code, and message, and does not return the updated developer information
UpdateDeveloperStatus.description_zh: 按开发者 ID 更新 HiMarket 开发者的状态，请求体提交目标状态与门户 ID；成功响应只返回 requestId、code 与 message，不回传更新后的开发者信息

UpdateGatewayElasticPolicy.description_en: Updates the elastic policy of a gateway

UpdateGatewayFeature.description_en: Updates the attribute parameters of a gateway

UpdateGatewayMaintenancePeriod.description_en: Modifies the O&M window of a gateway

UpdateGatewayName.description_en: Modifies the name of a gateway

UpdateGatewayQuotaRule.description_en: Updates a quota throttling rule on a gateway
UpdateGatewayQuotaRule.description_zh: 编辑网关上某条配额限流规则

UpdateGatewayQuotaRuleStatus.description_en: Enables or disables a quota throttling rule for a gateway
UpdateGatewayQuotaRuleStatus.description_zh: 启/停用网关某个配额限流规则

UpdateHttpApiRoute.description_en: Updates a route of an HTTP API

UpdateNetworkAccess.description_en: Changes the network access type of a gateway
UpdateNetworkAccess.description_zh: 更改网关网络访问类型

UpdatePortal.description_en: Updates the name, description, and portal configurations of a HiMarket developer portal by portal ID. The request body is in JSON format. A successful response returns the ID of the updated portal
UpdatePortal.description_zh: 按门户 ID 更新该 HiMarket 开发者门户的名称、描述与 Portal 配置，请求体为 JSON，成功响应返回被更新门户的 ID

UpdateProduct.description_en: Updates the name, description, type, documentation, icon, automatic subscription approval setting, product categories, and capabilities of an API product by API product ID. The request body is in JSON format. A successful response returns only the requestId, code, and message, and does not return the updated product information
UpdateProduct.description_zh: 按 API 产品 ID 更新该 API 产品的名称、描述、类型、说明文档、图标、订阅自动审批、所属产品类别与产品能力，请求体为 JSON；成功响应只返回 requestId、code 与 message，不回传更新后的产品信息

UpdateProductCategory.description_en: Updates the name, description, and icon of a product category by category ID. The request body is in JSON format. The response returns only the request ID, response status code, and response message
UpdateProductCategory.description_zh: 按产品类别 ID 更新该产品类别的名称、描述与图标，请求体为 JSON，响应只返回请求 ID、响应状态码与响应消息

UpdateRiskNotification.description_en: Updates the notification configuration for risk items

UpdateService.description_en: Updates a service. You can update the health check configuration, DNS domain name, and address configuration of fixed addresses for the service
UpdateService.description_zh: 更新服务。支持更新服务健康检查配置， DNS 域名和固定地址的地址配置信息
